hunks.baseline: Far off, he saw Perfected Being Hyeoncheon leaning against the corpse of a huge elephant, breathing faintly. The Dalai Lama froze.
hunks.sol: Far away, Perfected Being Hyeoncheon was leaning against the corpse of a huge elephant, drawing only the faintest breaths. The Dalai Lama froze.

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, the terrible heat that drove deep into his body gave him no time even for that instant.
hunks.sol: The terrible heat that drove deep into his body did not allow him even that instant.

hunks.baseline: His body trembled as if pierced by lightning.
hunks.sol: His body shuddered as if lightning had pierced it.

hunks.baseline: But not a drop of blood, not a single scream, came from him.
The flames had vaporized the blood that should have burst out and inflicted such distant, unbearable pain that he’d even forgotten how to cry out.
hunks.sol: Yet no blood spilled from him. Not a single scream escaped his lips. The flames had vaporized the blood that should have burst forth, and the pain was so overwhelming he forgot even to cry out.

hunks.baseline: But perhaps the greatest pain of all for the Dalai Lama was the low voice of his enemy, now piercing his ears.
hunks.sol: But perhaps the worst pain of all was his enemy’s low voice, sounding beside his ear.

hunks.baseline: “Fire King Jeok Cheongang says: Never harm a being who has something they must protect, even if that being is a beast.”
hunks.sol: “Fire King Jeok Cheongang says: Never harm a being who has something it must protect, even if that being is a beast.”

hunks.baseline: Like the ancestor who had carved his own words into a Potala Palace pillar, Jeok Cheongang whispered in a faint yet clear voice.
hunks.sol: Like the ancestor who had carved his own words into a Potala Palace pillar, Jeok Cheongang whispered in a faint but clear voice. His hand had pierced the Dalai Lama’s back and burst through his chest. He clenched it tight.

hunks.baseline: He clenched his hand, which had pierced through his enemy’s back and burst out through his chest.
The Dalai Lama couldn’t answer.
hunks.sol: The Dalai Lama could not answer.

hunks.baseline: Even as every sense connecting him to the world went dark, even as darkness swallowed his vision completely.
hunks.sol: His senses cut off from the world, and darkness swallowed his sight.

hunks.baseline: At last, his head slumped limply.
hunks.sol: At last, his head slumped.

hunks.baseline: Along with his enemy’s final words, echoing like Yama’s, the world surrounding the Dalai Lama closed in.
hunks.sol: With his enemy’s final words echoing like Yama’s, the Dalai Lama’s world closed around him.
